gbm_population_evidence.quote: Brain Tumor, Recurrent; Malignant Glioma (WHO Grade III or IV); IDH1/IDH2 Mutation
Patients must have recurrent malignant glioma with a history of WHO grade 3-4 IDH-mutant status

candidate_evidence.quote: Six patients will be treated with Topotecan by Convection-Enhanced Delivery.

treatment_setting_evidence.quote: Patients with recurrent malignant glioma, IDH-mutant, who have failed standard of care treatment are eligible.

tumour_pk_planned_evidence.quote: Tumoral and parenchymal distribution of gadolinium (measured by MRI) will be correlated with TPT levels (measured by mass spectrophotometry) in tissue samples obtained upon tumor resection.

role_evidence.quote: Six patients will be treated with Topotecan by Convection-Enhanced Delivery.

agents.drug_class_hint: topoisomerase I inhibitor chemotherapy, given by convection-enhanced delivery

role_evidence.quote: after which four cycles of TPT/gadolinium will be administered.

agents.drug_class_hint: gadolinium-based MRI contrast agent co-infused to image drug distribution

source_quote.quote: Patients with recurrent malignant glioma, IDH-mutant, who have failed standard of care treatment are eligible.

coder_notes: Only IDH-mutant WHO grade 3-4 glioma is enrolled, so not_glioblastoma under CNS5 despite the registry's mention of prior GBM work. Gadolinium is not a registered intervention but the protocol text says every patient receives TPT/gadolinium, so listed as diagnostic_agent. Drug distribution imaging is not counted as target engagement.
